subject: Next step: your Magnolia Media Group assessment
body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for your interest in the Brand Marketing Intern role at Magnolia Media Group. As the next step in our process, please complete the following assessment within 5 days:

https://assessments.example.com/magnolia/abc123

The game-based assessment takes about 25 minutes and works on a phone or laptop. There is nothing to study for.

Thanks,
Magnolia Media Group Early Careers
